layers.name: shared
layers.description: Shared value objects and pure types. No dependencies on other layers.

layers.name: db
layers.description: Data-access layer. May depend on shared and domain types only.

layers.name: domain
layers.description: Business logic. May depend on shared only.

layers.name: ui
layers.description: Presentation / service layer. May depend on domain and shared only.

allowedDependencies.reason: db may reference domain types for storage
domain may use shared value objects
ui may use shared types directly

forbiddenDependencies.reason: UI must not know about the data-access layer; route through domain instead.
shared is a lower-level package and must not import from higher-level domain.
shared must not import from ui.
domain must not import from ui.
domain must not import from db; db depends on domain, not the other way.
